title: StrictLocalInjectiveSourceRestriction
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$, $K$, $n$, $J$ and $q$
be as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison], and let $Q$ be
strict-local neighbourhood geometry [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry].
Use the specific constructed $A_i$, not arbitrary source isomorphisms. For each $i$,
the canonical source leg $\ell_i$ [def-weil-pbc-small-model-cohomology-germs]
followed by the global-sections homology map $m$ of the derived strict-local mate
[def-weil-pbc-small-model-mate-projection-data] is
$\ell_i m=A_i r_{Q_i,t_i,p} c_p T^{-1}$, where $r$ is termwise sections restriction,
$c_p$ is representativeSectionsComparison
[lem-weil-pbc-injective-sections-pullback-comparison], $p$ is the limit projection
and $T$ is smallModel_strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso. This only asserts the cone-leg equation
for the canonical comparison; it asserts neither transition naturality nor
invertibility of $c_p$. All mate target comparisons in this statement use the small coordinate-ring colimit model of [def-weil-pbc-small-model-mate-projection-data].

proof.text: Postcompose with the target isomorphism hom and apply the germ/derived-mate restriction identity.

Use the cone restriction conjunct of injectiveSections_strictLocal_comparison to replace stage representative comparison followed by derived unit, Leray and inverse composition by termwise restriction followed by limit representative comparison. Precompose by the canonical source comparison. Cancel target transport using its inverse/hom identity and associativity.

The geometry parameter is now the official canonical strictLocalization model. Use [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-small-model-geometry-transport] to express its cone on the original small colimit model. Replace legs, limit and the two component equations by smallModelLegs, smallModelIsLimit, smallModelFirst and smallModelOver. All cohomology objects, structural morphisms, source and target maps remain those in the original statement; the rest of the existing proof is unchanged.
Use the small-model germ legs without changing their component maps. The adopted six common derived-sections constructions are definitionally identical to the former local copies.

proof_origin.by: T6 adapting the complete existing proof along the canonical colimit-model comparison

lean.statement: theorem smallModel_strictLocalInjectiveSourceIso_restriction {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})) (n : ℤ) (Q : StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry f s) (J : CochainComplex.Plus (InjectiveObject (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))) (q : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj)) : ∀ i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s), ((smallModel_strictLocalCohomologySourceLegs s ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).obj K) n).app (op i)) ≫ ((Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).map ((mateEquiv (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).derivedPlus (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).derivedPlus (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).toCommSq).hom)) |>.natTrans.app K))) = (smallModel_strictLocalInjectiveSourceIso f s K n J q i).hom ≫ termwiseSectionsRestriction (Q.smallModelLegs.app i) ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i) (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) (Q.smallModelOver i).symm (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj) n ≫ representativeSectionsComparison (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)) q n ≫ (smallModel_strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso f s K n).inv
lean.note: Fully proved original small-colimit-model realization. The canonical upstream realization uses strictLocalization instead of strictHenselizationScheme and cannot be imported with the original Sheaf interfaces. Restores the proved StrictLocalSmallModel dependency chain previously landed in c03b8450536.
